name: Block transactional sender
description: Call this when you need to prevent a specific sender from being used for a contact's transactional emails. Use the corresponding unblock action if you instead need to lift the block.
preconditions: The contact identified by the email must already exist.

email.description: The email address of the contact whose sender is being blocked.

sender.description: The email address of the sender to block.

senderFrom.description: A label or identifier for the sender (e.g., a friendly name).

status.description: Result status, typically "success" when the block is applied.

side_effects: The specified sender is blocked for the given contact, preventing future transactional emails from that sender to the contact.
